cohort: 388 deliveries among women with ankylosing spondylitis and 1082 deliveries among matched controls from the general population in Sweden
finding: Women with ankylosing spondylitis had higher odds of emergency and elective Caesarean sections, preterm birth, and small-for-gestational-age offspring compared to controls.
mod_finding: Women with more extensive antirheumatic therapy exposures tended to have a higher risk for elective CS.
